title: 文章复盘 · 8题
meta: 2013 英语一 Reading Text 2 · 本篇问题 4 题 + 历史弱项 4 题 · 全部使用迁移语境
footer: 本篇复盘结果只有在你点击“提交结果到 GitHub”并在 GitHub 再点 Submit new issue 后，才会进入后续间隔复习。

questions.target: 共同动词支配 / 并列任务
questions.q: The inspector recommended replacing the worn belt and checking the tension before restarting the machine. Which reading preserves the recommendation?
o: The inspector reported that both jobs had already been completed.
Replacing the belt was expected to check the tension automatically.
The inspector recommended two tasks: belt replacement and a tension check.
The machine should be restarted before either task is attempted.

exp.trans: 检查员建议在重新启动机器之前更换磨损的皮带并检查张力。建议包含两项任务：更换皮带和检查张力，而不是报告它们已经完成。
exp.structure: The inspector是主语，recommended是谓语。replacing the worn belt与checking the tension是并列动名词短语，共同作recommended的补足内容；before restarting the machine给执行顺序。
exp.other: inspector 检查员；worn belt 磨损的皮带；tension 张力；restart 重新启动。
exp.meaning: and把两项动作放在同一层级，都受recommended支配。后一个动名词不是第一个动作自动产生的效果，也不是新的已完成事实。
exp.rest: had already been completed把建议改成过去已完成事实；check ... automatically把两项独立任务合成一项的自动效果；restarted before either task反转before给出的执行顺序。

questions.target: 具体反对行动支持哪条主旨
questions.skill: 例子→论点 / 不能多推态度变化
questions.q: A city report says proposals to digitize building permits have repeatedly stalled because established interests resist change. It cites a builders' association that organized petitions and delayed the new system for six months. What does the example mainly illustrate?
o: Organized groups can impede administrative reforms.
The association persuaded every resident to change political allegiance.
Most builders oppose the current political system in all circumstances.
Digital permits always cost more than paper applications.

exp.trans: 城市报告说，建筑许可数字化改革屡次被既有利益团体阻挠，并举建筑协会组织请愿、使新系统推迟六个月的例子。例子说明利益团体可能阻碍行政改革。
exp.structure: 主句proposals ... have stalled because...提出上层论点；It cites an association ...是作为证据的例子；organized petitions / delayed是例子中的行为与结果。
exp.other: digitize 数字化；permit 许可证；established interests 既有利益集团；administrative reform 行政改革。
exp.meaning: 例证题先找例子附近作者要证明的论点：改革遭遇阻力。组织请愿不等于改变公众政治立场；反对一项改革也不等于反对整个政治制度。
exp.rest: 政治归属改变需要前后态度证据；所有情况下反对现行政治制度扩大对象与频率；数字许可成本并未涉及。

questions.skill: 转折逻辑不是正负翻转
questions.q: The new timetable was designed to reduce delays. Yet average waiting time increased in its first month. Which relation is expressed?
o: 第二句说明第一句的目标已经实现。
第二句与第一句毫无逻辑关系，只是补充新数据。
实际结果违背了设计目标所产生的预期。
yet表示因为等待时间增加，所以才设计新时刻表。

exp.trans: 新的时刻表原本是为了减少延误而设计的，然而第一个月的平均等待时间反而增加了。这里是目标与实际结果之间的逆预期。
exp.structure: The new timetable是主语，was designed是被动谓语，to reduce delays说明目的；第二句average waiting time + increased。
exp.other: timetable 时刻表；delay 延误；average 平均的；waiting time 等待时间。
exp.meaning: 看到yet先问“前一句让我预期什么，后一句如何违背它”。不必先判断哪句是褒义、哪句是贬义。
exp.rest: “目标已经实现”与等待时间increased相矛盾；“毫无逻辑关系”忽略了减少延误的目标与实际等待时间之间的联系；“因为等待增加才设计时刻表”倒置了先设计、后观察结果的时间和因果方向。

questions.target: working out how=研究具体办法和补足省略
questions.skill: working out how=研究具体办法和补足省略
questions.q: A museum promised to put fragile manuscripts online, though it is still working out how. What is the museum still determining?
o: Whether the manuscripts ever existed.
Whether to close the museum.
How to make the manuscripts available online.
How to force visitors to buy expensive books.

exp.trans: 博物馆承诺将珍贵手稿上传网络，但仍在研究如何落实这一承诺。
exp.structure: though引导让步关系；working out how后省略to put fragile manuscripts online这一已知任务。
exp.other: manuscript手稿；fragile易损坏的；put online上传网络；work out想出办法。
exp.meaning: work out how强调拟定具体执行方法，how后往往可从前面承诺的动作恢复被省略的不定式。
exp.rest: 手稿存在与否、关闭场馆和强制购买书籍均不是已被明确承诺的行动。

questions.q:
The plumber thanked the neighbour. He had borrowed a ladder from the neighbour.
哪句合并正确？
o: The plumber thanked the neighbour from that he had borrowed a ladder.
The plumber thanked the neighbour whom from he had borrowed a ladder.
The plumber thanked the neighbour from whom he had borrowed a ladder.
The plumber thanked the neighbour whom he had borrowed a ladder from him.

exp.trans: 水管工感谢了那位借梯子给他的邻居。
exp.structure: 原始简单句：He had borrowed a ladder from the neighbour. → 用whom替代重复的the neighbour：the neighbour whom he had borrowed a ladder from → 把from前置：the neighbour from whom he had borrowed a ladder。外层主干是The plumber + thanked + the neighbour，后接修饰neighbour的定语从句。
exp.other: plumber 水管工；neighbour 邻居；ladder 梯子；borrow A from B 从B那里借来A。
exp.meaning: from不是临时猜出来的，来自原句borrow...from...；先行词是人，介词后用whom。
exp.rest: from that：关系代词that不能直接置于介词后。whom from he：介词前置时必须是from whom，不是whom from。from him：关系代词whom已经代替该人，再保留him造成重复。

questions.q: After weeks of testing, engineers finally cracked a difficult battery problem and improved the prototype's reliability. What does cracked mean?
o: Physically smashed every battery.
Successfully solved a technical problem.
Refused to study the issue.
Created another failure accidentally.

exp.trans: 经过数周测试，工程师终于攻克电池难题，提高了原型机的可靠性。
exp.structure: finally cracked a difficult battery problem中cracked及物，problem为宾语；improved说明解决后的积极结果。
exp.meaning: crack除了裂开，还可接code、problem等表示破解或攻克；具体意思取决于宾语和上下文。
exp.rest: 砸开电池是未经提及的物理行为；拒绝研究及制造失败与finally和improved形成的逻辑不合。

questions.target: 跨句识别负责执行的主体
questions.skill: 跨句识别负责执行的主体
questions.q: A council built a website where residents could ask outside contractors to stop marketing messages. The contractors promised to comply. Who is responsible for changing the outgoing messages?
o: The outside contractors.
The residents who used the form.
The council members who created the site.
The unrelated firms hosting the city's internet connection.

exp.trans: 市议会提供请求渠道，居民提出停止消息的要求，但真正承诺停止发送营销信息的是外部承包商。
exp.structure: 第一句council built引出平台建设者；第二句The contractors promised to comply明确承诺者和履行请求的执行方。
exp.other: council市议会；contractor承包商；comply遵守；marketing message营销信息。
exp.meaning: 指代分析不能只看上文最近被提到的组织，还要核对承诺、执行和发送行为对应的真实主语。
exp.rest: 居民是请求方，市议会是平台建设方；互联网连接服务商没有参与这项承诺，也没有文本证据表明它能停止消息。

questions.q: A quarrel divided a library committee: some members wanted fines for late returns, but others worried fines would discourage reading. What is a quarrel here?
o: A new library card.
A disagreement over policy.
A list of paid penalties.
An agreement supported by every member.

exp.trans: 委员会围绕是否对逾期还书收取罚款产生争执，不同成员持有相反看法。
exp.structure: A quarrel是句子主语；some members...but others...明确呈现两方存在意见分歧。
exp.other: late return逾期归还；fine罚款；discourage阻碍积极性；member成员。
exp.meaning: quarrel是争吵或争论，在政策话题中可指观点分歧，并非一定发生肢体冲突。
exp.rest: 借书证、罚款名单不是讨论过程；全体一致的协议与两派相互反对的事实矛盾。

parallel-governance.q: Which sentence has a clean parallel structure in which the same modal verb governs both alternatives?
o: The technician can either replace the sensor or recalibrate the device.
The technician either can replace the sensor or recalibration of the device.
The technician can either replacing the sensor or recalibrate the device.
The technician can either replace the sensor or the device is recalibrated.

exp.trans: 正确句：技术员可以要么更换传感器，要么重新校准设备。
exp.structure: 主干：The technician（主语）+ can（情态动词）+ either replace... or recalibrate...。can同时支配replace和recalibrate，两边都是动词原形，结构完全平行。
exp.other: technician 技术员；sensor 传感器；recalibrate 重新校准；device 设备。
exp.meaning: 共同动词支配时，并列两端应保持同一语法层级。这里 can + replace / recalibrate。
exp.rest: either can replace... or recalibration... 把动词结构和名词结构并列；can either replacing... 中情态动词后不能接-ing形式；replace... or the device is recalibrated 把动词短语和完整从句并列，层级不一致。

parallel-governance.q: The redesign owes its success not to a faster motor but to a simpler control panel. Which reading keeps the shared relation intact?
o: The faster motor owes its success to the control panel.
The redesign’s success is attributed to the simpler panel rather than the faster motor.
The simpler panel was made possible by the redesign’s earlier success.
The sentence credits the motor and the panel equally.

exp.trans: 这次重新设计的成功不是由于更快的电机，而是由于更简单的控制面板。两个to短语共同说明同一个成功应归因于什么。
exp.structure: The redesign是主语，owes是谓语，its success是宾语。not to a faster motor和but to a simpler control panel是同层并列的归因补足语，都受owes its success支配。
exp.other: redesign 重新设计；owe A to B 把A归因于B；motor 电机；control panel 控制面板。
exp.meaning: 共享的是owe success to...的归因结构，不是让后半句生成新主语或改变成功的所属对象。not...but...排除电机、强调面板。
exp.rest: The faster motor owes...把电机改成主语并换掉success所属对象；panel was made possible...把面板作为成功的结果，反转因果；equally忽略not对电机解释的排除。

example-claim-scope.target: 例子与论点的对应范围
example-claim-scope.skill: 不能靠团体行动推固定结论
example-claim-scope.q: An article argues that locally organized groups can sometimes help an unpopular policy get started. It describes a farmers' cooperative that trained volunteers and persuaded members to test a water-saving system, helping the trial begin on schedule. What is the role of this example?
o: It proves every member had opposed water conservation before joining.
It shows cooperatives necessarily control the national government.
It establishes that all unpopular policies eventually succeed.
It supports the claim that organized groups can facilitate policy implementation.

exp.trans: 文章认为地方组织有时能帮助不受欢迎的政策启动，随后举农民合作社培训志愿者、推动成员试用节水系统，使试验按时开展的例子。这个例子是在支持‘团体也能帮助政策落实’。
exp.structure: An article argues + that从句是主张；It describes...引出实例；helping the trial begin是实例中的实际结果。
exp.other: cooperative 合作社；facilitate 促进；implementation 落实；trial 试行。
exp.meaning: 例子支持的结论可以是促进改革，也可以是阻碍改革，取决于前后文。不要机械地把‘团体动员’与‘妨碍改革’绑定。
exp.rest: 成员加入前态度没有交代；合作社对国家政府的控制与本文无关；一次成功试行不能保证所有政策最终成功。

example-claim-scope.skill: 识别反例对充分条件的限制而非扩大成全面否定
example-claim-scope.q: A consultant argues that longer opening hours are enough to widen access to museums. A writer responds with a neighbourhood museum that stayed open until 10 p.m., yet attracted few additional night-shift workers. Interviews revealed that the last bus serving their workplaces left at 8 p.m. Why does the writer include this case?
o: To show that transport constraints can limit what extended hours achieve.
To identify reduced bus services as a consequence of the later museum hours.
To compare tourists' reasons for visiting with those of local residents.
To present later opening as a substitute for improving transport links.

exp.trans: 顾问认为，只要延长开放时间，就足以让更多人有机会参观博物馆。作者回应说，一家社区博物馆开放到晚上十点，却几乎没有多吸引夜班工人。访谈发现，途经他们工作地点的末班公交在晚上八点就开走了。作者为何举这个例子？为了说明交通限制会影响延长开放时间的实际效果。
exp.structure: A consultant + argues + that从句提出待检验的充分条件；A writer + responds with + a museum引出反例。that stayed open...为修饰museum的定语从句；yet转向预期未实现的结果；Interviews + revealed + that从句提供限制条件。
exp.other: widen access 扩大参与机会；neighbourhood 社区；night-shift worker 夜班工人；extended hours 延长的开放时间；transport link 交通连接。
exp.meaning: 例子针对的是延长开放时间是否单独就足够。公交仍是障碍，说明措施的效果受另一条件限制；没有证明延时开放普遍无效，也没有比较不同群体的喜好。
exp.rest: 末班车时间是已有约束，文中没有说公交服务因博物馆延时而削减；游客与本地居民的参观动机没有被比较；例子指出仅延时仍不足，不能反说延时可以替代交通改善。

example-claim-scope.skill: 把实例放回可见记录与实际行为的区分
example-claim-scope.q: An essay distinguishes a visible change in records from a change in underlying behaviour. It describes a factory where reported near-misses increased after a safety bonus was introduced. An anonymous survey found no change in how often hazards occurred; workers said they had previously kept quiet about them. What does the case illustrate?
o: A safety bonus can make a workplace more dangerous even when workers welcome it.
Anonymous surveys provide weaker safety evidence than official incident totals.
Workers respond more strongly to anonymity than to financial rewards.
Recorded events can increase because reporting changes, without a matching increase in hazards.

exp.trans: 文章区分记录上的可见变化与实际行为的变化。文中举例，一家工厂引入安全奖励后，上报的险情增多。匿名调查发现，危险出现的频率并没有变化；工人说自己以前对这些情况保持沉默。这个例子说明，记录数量上升可能源自上报方式改变，而不意味着危险同步增加。
exp.structure: An essay + distinguishes + A from B提出上层区分；It + describes + a factory引出例子，where从句补充上报数量变化。was introduced是被动谓语。An anonymous survey + found + no change；how often hazards occurred补充频率。had previously kept quiet指出早期漏报背景。
exp.other: near-miss 险些发生的事故、险情；underlying 实际的、深层的；anonymous 匿名的；hazard 危险因素；incident total 事件总数。
exp.meaning: 实例在支持记录变化不等于实际事件变化这一论点。新增上报与此前沉默形成对照，不能把记录增多直接推成工作更危险；也不应把例证题改答成未讨论的奖励与匿名措施孰强。
exp.rest: 奖励后上报增多不能证明危险增多，调查反而指出发生频率未变；文中没有比较匿名调查和正式记录的证据等级；匿名是调查方式，奖励是先前制度变化，材料没有直接比较二者激励强度。

expectation-contrast.skill: 转折逻辑不是正负翻转
expectation-contrast.q: The manual warns that the batteries may fail below zero. Yet the field team left them outside overnight during a freeze. What does yet mainly signal?
o: 前句是负面，因此后句必须表达一个正面结果。
后句给出一个与前文警告所形成的合理预期相违的现实行为。
后句解释了为什么低温不会影响电池。
yet表示两件事按时间先后自然发生，没有对比。

exp.trans: 手册警告电池在零度以下可能失效。然而，野外团队却在严寒中把它们整夜放在室外。yet强调现实行为违背了前文警告所带来的正常预期。
exp.structure: 第一句The manual + warns + that从句。第二句the field team + left + them + outside；during a freeze交代环境。yet连接两个完整命题。
exp.other: manual 手册；battery 电池；below zero 零度以下；freeze 严寒/冰冻天气。
exp.meaning: yet/however/nevertheless的核心是命题层面的逆预期，不是“前负后正”或“前正后负”的机械符号。这里前文让人预期团队会避免低温，现实却相反。
exp.rest: “负面后必须是正面”把转折误解成情感极性，后句其实是无视警告的行为；“解释低温不会影响电池”既与警告相冲突，也没有文本依据；“自然的时间先后”忽略了yet所标记的预期与现实之间的反差。

workout-how-ellipsis.target: work out how to do sth.=找到可行方法
workout-how-ellipsis.skill: work out how to do sth.=找到可行方法
workout-how-ellipsis.q: The scientists agree that the river must be cleaned. However, they have not worked out how to remove the chemical residue safely. What is still unresolved?
o: The practical method for safe removal.
Whether the river exists.
Whether all chemicals are harmless.
Whether cleaning has already finished.

exp.trans: 研究者一致认为河流需要清理，但尚未想出安全去除化学残留物的方法。
exp.structure: 首句说明明确目标；however后not worked out how to remove表达具体操作方法仍未确定。
exp.other: residue残留物；remove去除；safely安全地；unresolved尚未解决的。
exp.meaning: work out how to do sth.表示弄清楚怎样做，不是‘工作完毕’，更不是不知道问题是否存在。
exp.rest: 河流存在和需要清理已经明确；清理尚未完成，化学物是否无害也不是句子悬而未决的核心。

relative.q:
The archive contains several letters. The historian based her argument on those letters.
最自然的合并是：
o: The archive contains several letters on which the historian based her argument.
The archive contains several letters which on the historian based her argument.
The archive contains several letters on that the historian based her argument.
The archive contains several letters which the historian based her argument on them.

diag.1: 介词 on 应放在关系代词 which 前，不能写 which on the historian...
diag.2: 介词后不能用关系代词 that；应使用 which。
diag.3: which 已经代替 those letters，后面再用 them 造成重复。

exp.trans: 这个档案馆收藏着几封信，历史学家正是依据这些信件提出了她的论证。
exp.structure: 原始简单句：The historian based her argument on those letters. → those letters 变成先行词 several letters，并用 which 代替：the letters which the historian based her argument on → 正式写法把介词前置：the letters on which the historian based her argument。
exp.other: archive 档案馆；historian 历史学家；base A on B 以B为依据建立A；argument 论证/观点。
exp.meaning: 介词 + which 用于物；介词来自原简单句中的搭配 base A on B。
exp.rest: 介词前置的正确句是 “letters on which ...”；把 which 放在 on 前、把 that 放在介词后，或在 which 后再保留 them，都会造成词序或关系词重复问题。

crack-polysemy.q: The committee had twenty files to review before lunch. Its chair said, 'We had better get cracking on these applications.' What did the chair mean?
o: Find cracks in the paper folders.
Delay the work until next month.
Argue about the names of all the files.
Start reviewing the files without delay.

exp.trans: 委员会午餐前需要审查二十份文件，主席催促大家立刻着手审查。
exp.structure: had twenty files to review描述紧迫任务；get cracking on these applications在引语中表达催促启动工作。
exp.other: committee委员会；application申请材料；review审查；without delay不要拖延。
exp.meaning: get cracking是习惯表达，意思是立即行动；不能把crack名词裂缝的字面意义套用到整个短语。
exp.rest: 破损纸张没有依据；延迟或争论文件命名都和午餐前必须审查的工作目标矛盾。

dnt-actor-boundary.target: 提出请求、提供设置、执行响应的主体
dnt-actor-boundary.skill: 提出请求、提供设置、执行响应的主体
dnt-actor-boundary.q: A news app lets users send an opt-out notice to independent advertising partners. The app supplies the switch; the partners must decide whether to stop profiling users. Which interpretation preserves the roles?
o: The app alone decides whether all advertisers stop profiling.
The app offers the setting, while the advertising partners handle requests.
The users created the advertising partners' software.
The advertising partners are the only parties who can send opt-out notices.

exp.trans: 新闻应用提供开关，用户借此发出退出通知，而收到通知的广告合作方需要决定如何响应。
exp.structure: 第一句说明app提供的渠道与用户动作，第二句分别用The app和the partners指明执行开关与处理请求的主体。
exp.other: opt-out notice退出通知；profiling用户画像；independent独立的；advertising partner广告合作方。
exp.meaning: 将创建界面、发送用户偏好和执行请求分开，不能将相关业务主体一概等同为同一家公司。
exp.rest: 只由应用负责所有广告商的行动与原文partners decide相反；用户和广告方软件开发、唯一发送者均未得到原文支持。

finegrain-quarrel.q: A utility's monthly total shows how much water was used. Its fine-grained records additionally show the hourly use of each building. Here fine-grained means:
o: Only the yearly average is recorded.
Records are necessarily inaccurate.
Detailed across smaller units and intervals.
Information is completely unavailable.

exp.trans: 供水公司既有月度用水总量，也有按建筑和小时拆分的细致记录；后者就是细粒度信息。
exp.structure: monthly total与fine-grained records对照；additionally引出能够分别查看的更小时间和空间单位。
exp.other: utility公用事业机构；monthly每月的；hourly每小时的；interval时间间隔。
exp.meaning: fine-grained指信息足够精细，可按较小类别展开；并不自动表示更准确或更涉及私人隐私。
exp.rest: 仅有年度平均数与按小时和建筑拆分冲突；不准确或完全不可获得都不是细粒度的定义。
